title: Independent review findings
description: Written by a reviewer in a fresh context from the packet scripts/review.sh produces, submitted with `harness review submit FILE` after terminal confirmation or a one-time receipt from a native user-prompt hook bound to the run, findings file, and project tree, and required by `harness review done`. scripts/review_findings.py enforces it.

tree_hash.description: scripts/tree-hash.sh of the project when reviewed; printed in the packet. Any later edit voids the review.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed, e.g. subagent:code-reviewer or claude -p.

criteria.description: Optional answers to the task contract's acceptance criteria, one per id. A not_met answer blocks review done like an open major finding.

id.description: The acceptance criterion's id in the contract.

evidence.description: Command and result, test, or file:line.
